strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Gukuraho Google yuzuye:

• Gukuraho Play Store + Google Play ibikorwa + Amakuru y'Ibikorwa.

• Igikoresho kirasubira gukora ubwaco inyuma.

Uravyemeza?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: isuzuma akazu k'urufunguzo kariho ubu ku rutonde rw'ibikurwako rwa Google (CRL) maze igagerageza inkomoko nyinshi gushika ibonye akazu k'urufunguzo kabereye, n'ugusubira inyuma kwikora no gusubira gutangura ibikorwa vya Google. Ikora ku ruzitiro rwose kandi ikeneye internet (iminota 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox kuva ku rubuga: ikura keybox mu bubiko buzwi (GitHub) ikayibika kuri /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Ikeneye internet kandi ifata iminota 1-3. Ikoreshwa igihe smart fetch inanirwa canke igihe keybox yahinduwe n'amaboko.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP isuzuma: igenzura ibice vy'Itanga Urufunguzo rwo Kure biriho, igenzura TEE verisiyo y'icete c'icemezo, kandi yerekana uko igikoresho ca KmInstallKeybox kimeze. Ntaco ihindura — ukuntu igikoresho kimeze.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine gusuzuma (gusoma gusa): yerekana Widevine ibimenyetso vy'urugero (L1/L3) bivuye kuri dumpsys, DRM (IDM) urufunguzo-dosiye kubaho, n'imiterere ya sisitemu bijanye. Ntaco ihindura na gato.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Igitabo RKP gukosora: gikoresha sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh igitabo. Gutorera umuti ibibazo vy’ugushingira intahe iyo urupapuro rw’urugendo rwikora rudakora. Igihe cose umuntu agenda acapura umurongo utomoye w’uguterimbere/ukunanirwa.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Gukosora RKP vyuzuye: bikoresha sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh vyuzuye. Ifata ingingo zikomeye kandi ifata igihe kirekire. Iciyumviro gitomoye kiraboneka ku mpera.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Gusubiramwo GMS: gukuraho amakuru y’ibikorwa vya Play Store na Google (GMS+GSF) maze ugasubira gufungura igikoresho ubwaco. Ku bijanye n’ugushingira intahe gusa — ntivyigera bikora ku mafoto yawe canke ku madosiye yawe.
strings.mdCertify: • Icemezo co gukina: isuzuma RKP icemezo c'icemezo c'igikoresho maze igasubiramwo imiterere y'icemezo iyo bikenewe. Ntikora ku makuru y'abakoresha.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER gusana: gukosora Google ibibazo vy'inzego z'ibikorwa (SOTER) bijanye n'ugushingira intahe ibikoresho. Ikoreshwa ku bikoresho bimwe bimwe vyishingikiriza kuri SOTER aho gukoresha Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Gukoresha PIF: gukoresha sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh inguvu. Gukoresha ikimenyetso c'urutoke catowe (co mu karere/giteye imbere) maze ugahindura amadosiye pif.prop/pif.json. Igisubizo gitomoye kiraboneka mu gitabu.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: yerekana uko moteri ishizweho, amadosiye y'ibimenyetso vy'intoke (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), n'ibitabo. Suzuma gusa — ntaco bihindura.
strings.mdCanary: • Ivugurura ry’Ikanari: rikoresha sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Izana igisohoka ca Canary Engine gishasha kugira ngo ibone ko ihuye n'ivyemezo vy'ingenzi RKP (Gashyantare 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Gupima moteri: igenzura TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), amadosiye y’agasanduku k’imfunguruzo (ikora n’ikoresha), urutoke rw’igikoresho nyaco n’urw’ibinyoma, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP imfunguruzo. Iyerekanwa ry’isuzuma gusa.
strings.hintKbSlots: Ico kiganiro gicungera ibibanza bibiri vy’urufunguzo: ivy’intango (vyeranda, ntivyigera bihanagurwa) n’ivy’inyuma (ivy’inyuma). Iyi tab yerekana ikibanza gikora, ihindura ivyo ukunda, canke itera imbere ivy'inyuma ku vy'intango ku busabe butomoye — n'ibisubizo n'inyandiko yuzuye.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Gupima ubutungane: isuzuma TEE urufunguzo rwo kwinjiza, urushinge rw'ibitabo imbere muri keystore2, ikibanza co gukuraho (CRL), igitigiri c'urutonde rw'uburinzi n'ikibanza RKP. Gusoma gusa — ntaco bihindura.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Urutonde rw'uburinzi rurasubirwamwo kuva kuri porogaramu yose yashizweho.
• Igipande c'ubufatanye bwa custom-ROM kirasubirwamwo.
• Ububiko bw'urufunguzo bukora burasubirwamwo.
#• #000. restarted.

Nta kintu na kimwe gifutwa kandi akazu k'urufunguzo rwa mbere ntikakozweko.

Bandanya?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Ivyumba vy’amasandugu y’urufunguzo: yerekana uko ivyumba vy’intango n’ivy’inyuma vyifashe kandi igahindura ivyo ukunda hagati yavyo. Ivya mbere (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) vyama birinzwe kandi ntivyigera bihanagurwa. Gutera imbere ivy'inyuma gushika ku vy'intango bisaba kwemezwa mu buryo butomoye.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Guteza imbere igice ca kabiri ku gice ca mbere:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bica bihinduka ibirimwo igice ca mbere.
• Ivya mbere biriho ubu birabikwa nk'ivy'inyuma imbere y'uko bisubirwamwo.
• Nta kintu na kimwe gisubirwamwo — igikorwa kirashobora gusubirwamwo.6##00.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Kuraho ikibanza ca kabiri:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml kizokurwaho.
• Ikibanza ca mbere ntikikozweko.

Ubandanya?
